instructions: Build the approved low, open Scavenger hand-work bay. At the 64-inch Room A camera, preserve one broad workbench, one hand vise, one blue tool board with a few large separated tools, and a clear entrance. Use visible supports under the shallow galvanized canopy, a single small outer canvas repair, and a small parts crate or short stock rack. Keep the work function distinct from Depot and housing. Fit the 23 x 9 x 12 inch envelope. Presentation only; no gameplay changes.
tool: Blender component authoring with geometry-built work surfaces and embedded PBR salvage materials.
material_method: Broad timber, enamel and galvanized material blocks carry the work-area identity at gameplay distance; PBR patina adds close-range response.
